report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: traces OK at 66ms, error_rate 0.0012, p95 75ms, INFO/200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services in the topology are unobserved. Handing off for evidence of the actual incident window and downstream telemetry.
